question: The ‘PRASHAD’ scheme of the Government of India is associated with which ministry of the government?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Tourism.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **'Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual, Heritage Augmentation Drive' **(PRASAD) scheme was launched by the **Ministry of Tourism.**
 
• PRASAD' is a **central scheme **to develop pilgrimage and heritage destinations in the country.
 
• The nomenclature of the scheme changed from PRASAD to “National Mission on Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual, Heritage Augmentation Drive (PRASHAD) in **October 2017.**
 
• The objective of the PRASHAD scheme is to develop pilgrim sites across the country to enrich the religious tourism experience.
 
• PRASHAD Scheme thrust is on the integrated development of pilgrimage destinations in a planned, prioritized, and sustainable manner to provide a complete religious tourism experience.

The main objective of the Prasad Scheme is to 

 
• Harness tourism for **employment generation** and economic development.
 
• Development of **world-class** infrastructure in religious destinations. 
 
• Promotion of** local art culture handicrafts and cuisine. **
 
• ​The total number of sites identified for development under the scheme at present is 41.
 
• PRASHAD scheme is 100% funded by the Central Government at most of the pilgrim sites, if required arrangements under the Corporate Social Responsibility and Public-Private Partnerships can be made.
